title: config_push (hub -> agent)
description: Desired agent configuration. Sent in full after hello_ack when versions differ, then as deltas (full=false, only changed sections present) whenever routing, egress rules, engine catalog, CRL, settings or the signed security policy change. The agent applies atomically, persists to <state_dir>/config.json, and answers with an event config_applied (or config_rejected with details). config_version is monotonic per node; the agent ignores pushes with a version <= the one it holds unless full=true.

full.description: True = replace everything (absent sections mean empty). False = merge present sections only.

routing.description: Instances the agent proxy on :9443 must expose, with their local target. The proxy maps /instances/{instance_id}/... to 127.0.0.1:{port}, rewrites the JSON body field model to served_model_name when rewrite_model=true, and allows only allowed_path_prefixes.

allowed_path_prefixes.description: e.g. ["/v1/chat/completions","/v1/completions","/v1/embeddings","/v1/rerank","/health"] — engine admin paths (/slots, /models/*, /props POST, /metrics) are never listed.

accepting.description: False while draining: proxy returns 503 Retry-After for new requests.

max_concurrent.description: Proxy-enforced cap; excess requests queue up to settings.proxy.queue_timeout_seconds then 503.

egress_allowlist.description: Hosts/CIDRs the node may reach besides the control plane. Entries: hostname, hostname:port, CIDR, or CIDR:port. The agent programs pf/nftables; anything else outbound is dropped and logged as egress_blocked.

engine_catalog.description: Engine versions available for this node's platform (artifact already selected). Lets the agent pre-download engine binaries/images.

crl.description: Revoked certificates. The proxy rejects client certs whose serial or fingerprint is listed, even if they chain to the CA.

ca_bundle_pem.description: Updated CA bundle (CA rotation); the agent trusts both until the next rotation completes.

security.description: Signed node security policy (added 2026-11-24, protocol.md §13): pinned hub and API-layer key fingerprints (SPKI sha256), outbound tunnel endpoints, direct-mode source allow-list and rate limits, SSH-instance default source CIDRs. Present in every full push and in a delta when it changed; older agents ignore it.

model_sources.description: Mirror endpoints for offline sites (no tokens here; tokens travel inside load/prefetch commands).

log_forward.description: Forward engine stdout/stderr as log events.

cache_min_free_bytes.description: Agent-side LRU sweep triggers below this free space (unpinned only).

allowed_client_subjects.description: X.509 subject O/CN values accepted on :9443, default ["O=gpudeck-services"].
